title: Vikram and Betal: The Lost Necklace

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a lost necklace.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a queen who lost her necklace.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: The king asked everyone to find the missing necklace.
scenes.image_prompt: queen worried about missing necklace cartoon

scenes.text: The minister gave sticks to all servants and said they were magical.
scenes.image_prompt: minister giving sticks to servants cartoon

scenes.text: The thief cut his stick out of fear.
The shorter stick revealed the thief. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: minister pointing at guilty servant while others watch cartoon

story: A queen lost her necklace. A clever minister used a trick with sticks to find the thief. The guilty servant revealed himself out of fear. Vikram said fear exposes truth.
